hardened-screwdriver.action: Improved electrical repair or rewiring attempt.

dementonite-screwdriver.action: Dementonite electrical repair or improvised attack.

dementonite-wrench.action: Dementonite mechanical repair or improvised attack.

heavy-wrench.action: Heavy mechanical repair or breaching attempt.

welding-tool.action: Repairs one hull or welded-structure task.

plasma-cutter.action: Cuts one wreck, door, or structure section.

fire-extinguisher.action: Suppresses one increment of fire or creates a short push.

sprayer.action: Applies one dose of the loaded liquid.

cargo-scooter.action: Provides one movement interval while hauling cargo.

flashlight.action: Provides one scene or interval of illumination.

reactor-pda.action: Performs one reactor monitoring or control interval.

sonar-beacon.action: Deploys the beacon at the current location.

fixfoam-grenade.action: Deploys emergency repair foam to seal a hull breach.

toolbelt.action: When equipped, adds four tracked inventory slots.

backpack.action: When equipped, adds four tracked inventory slots and imposes a one-point effective Agility penalty.

bandolier.action: Wearable ammunition organization; ammunition remains tracked normally.

storage-container.action: Portable organization container; it may also be placed in submarine cargo.

artifact-transport-case.action: Protects and isolates one transported artifact.

consumableEffects.battery-cell: Restores one full charge cycle to a compatible electrical tool or weapon.
consumableEffects.fulgurium-battery-cell: Restores one full high-capacity charge cycle to a compatible electrical tool or weapon.
consumableEffects.fuel-rod: Adds one standard reactor-fuel unit to submarine cargo or refuels a compatible reactor operation.
consumableEffects.thorium-fuel-rod: Adds one long-duration thorium reactor-fuel unit to submarine cargo.
consumableEffects.fulgurium-fuel-rod: Adds one high-output reactor-fuel unit to submarine cargo.
consumableEffects.volatile-fulgurium-fuel-rod: Adds one hazardous high-output reactor-fuel unit; mishandling may trigger a volatility consequence.
consumableEffects.oxygen-tank: Refills one compatible diving or cutting device with a standard oxygen supply.
consumableEffects.oxygenite-tank: Refills one compatible device with an enhanced oxygen supply.
consumableEffects.welding-fuel-tank: Refills one welding tool with a standard fuel supply.
consumableEffects.incendium-fuel-tank: Refills one compatible fuel-using tool or weapon with incendiary fuel.
consumableEffects.flare: Creates a bright temporary light and signal at the current location.
consumableEffects.glowstick: Creates a low-output chemical light for one scene or travel interval.
consumableEffects.alien-power-cell: Restores one alien-energy weapon or device charge cycle.
consumableEffects.bandage: Treats bleeding and minor wounds; consume one use when applied.
consumableEffects.plastiseal: Treats severe bleeding and burns; consume one use when applied.
consumableEffects.saline: Treats blood loss with a basic infusion; consume one use when administered.
consumableEffects.blood-pack: Treats major blood loss; consume one use when administered.
consumableEffects.pomegrenade-extract: Provides minor healing and helps oxygen deprivation; consume one use.
consumableEffects.morphine: Treats internal injury and pain, with overdose and addiction risk; consume one use.
consumableEffects.fentanyl: Treats major internal injury, with severe overdose and addiction risk; consume one use.
consumableEffects.deusizine: Provides high-grade emergency trauma treatment or revival support; consume one use.
consumableEffects.liquid-oxygenite: Provides slow bloodstream oxygen support and mild toxicity; consume one use.
consumableEffects.adrenaline: Provides short-term anti-stun and unconsciousness resistance; consume one use.
consumableEffects.broad-spectrum-antibiotics: Treats infection or supplies an advanced medical recipe; consume one use when administered.
consumableEffects.stabilozine: Stabilizes a patient or contributes to an antidote treatment; consume one use.
consumableEffects.ethanol: Causes intoxication or supplies a chemical recipe; consume one use.
consumableEffects.opium: Provides pain treatment or an opiate ingredient, with dependency risk; consume one use.
consumableEffects.alien-blood: Supplies one alien-biological medical dose or crafting ingredient.
consumableEffects.methamphetamine: Provides temporary speed and wakefulness with addiction and overdose risk; consume one use.
consumableEffects.anabolic-steroids: Provides temporary physical-performance support; consume one use.
consumableEffects.hyperzine: Provides advanced speed and physical-performance stimulation; consume one use.
consumableEffects.pressure-stabilizer: Provides temporary protection from pressure trauma; consume one use.
consumableEffects.combat-stimulant: Provides temporary combat recovery and performance support; consume one use.
consumableEffects.tonic-liquid: Provides stimulant recovery support; consume one use.
consumableEffects.energy-drink: Provides temporary alertness; consume one use.
consumableEffects.haloperidol: Treats psychosis and hallucination-related conditions; consume one use.
consumableEffects.naloxone: Treats opiate overdose, addiction, or withdrawal; consume one use.
consumableEffects.calyxanide: Treats husk infection; consume one use.
consumableEffects.deliriumine-antidote: Treats deliriumine poisoning; consume one use.
consumableEffects.morbusine-antidote: Treats morbusine poisoning; consume one use.
consumableEffects.cyanide-antidote: Treats cyanide poisoning; consume one use.
consumableEffects.sufforin-antidote: Treats sufforin poisoning; consume one use.
consumableEffects.antirad: Treats radiation sickness; consume one use.
consumableEffects.calyx-extract: Applies a husk-related biological dose; this is hazardous rather than restorative.
consumableEffects.paralyzant: Applies a paralysis-inducing dose; this is a poison.
consumableEffects.deliriumine: Applies a psychosis-inducing dose; this is a poison.
consumableEffects.morbusine: Applies a breathing- and movement-impairing neurotoxin dose.
consumableEffects.cyanide: Applies a rapidly lethal poison dose.
consumableEffects.sufforin: Applies a potent poison dose requiring a dedicated antidote.
consumableEffects.chloral-hydrate: Applies a sedative dose or supplies a chemical recipe.
consumableEffects.crimson-acid: Applies a highly corrosive acid dose.
